import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int N;
    static List<String> mat;
    static List<String> mat2;
    static int[][] v1;
    static class FloodFill {
        static void flood(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(x * N + y);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int front = q.poll();
                int cx = front / N;
                int cy = front % N;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nx = cx + dx[d];
                    int ny = cy + dy[d];
                    if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || v[nx][ny] != -1 || mat.get(nx).charAt(ny) == 'Y')
                        continue;
                    if (Character.isDigit(mat2.get(nx).charAt(ny)) && mat2.get(nx).charAt(ny) != '0' && (v[cx][cy] + 1 <= v1[nx][ny] || v1[nx][ny] == -1)) {
                        v[nx][ny] = v[cx][cy] + 1;
                        if (v[nx][ny] != v1[nx][ny])
                            q.offer(nx * N + ny);
                    } else if (v1[nx][ny] == -1 || v1[nx][ny] > v[cx][cy] + 1) {
                        v[nx][ny] = v[cx][cy] + 1;
                        q.offer(nx * N + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        static void init(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(v[i], -1);
            }
            v[x][y] = 0;
            flood(x, y, v);
        }
        static void buildGraph(List<String> m, List<int[][]> v) {
            v.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
                v.add(new int[N][N]);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    if (Character.isDigit(m.get(i).charAt(j)) && m.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                        init(i, j, v.get(i * N + j));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static int maxN = 110;

    static class Node {
        int from, to, cost, flow;
        Node(int f, int t, int c, int fl) {
            this.from = f;
            this.to = t;
            this.cost = c;
            this.flow = fl;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int totalNodes;
        int[] cost, flow, parent;
        List<Node> edges;
        int totalCost, totalFlow;

        MinCostFlow() {
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> getResults() {
            return new Pair<>(totalCost, totalFlow);
        }

        int getFlow() {
            return totalFlow;
        }

        int getCost() {
            return totalCost;
        }

        void reset(int n) {
            maxN = totalNodes = n;
            cost = new int[n];
            flow = new int[n];
            parent = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(cost, INF);
            Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            edges.clear();
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c, int f) {
            edges.add(new Node(u, v, c, f));
            edges.add(new Node(v, u, -c, 0));
        }

        void findPath(int s, int t) {
            reset(maxN);
            flow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            cost[s] = 0;
            boolean changed;
            for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; i++) {
                changed = false;
                for (int idx = 0; idx < edges.size(); idx++) {
                    Node e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (e.flow > 0 && cost[e.to] > cost[e.from] + e.cost) {
                        cost[e.to] = cost[e.from] + e.cost;
                        flow[e.to] = Math.min(flow[e.from], e.flow);
                        parent[e.to] = idx;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
                if (!changed) break;
            }
        }

        void run(int s, int t) {
            if (s == t) {
                totalCost = 0;
                totalFlow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            }
            totalCost = 0;
            totalFlow = 0;
            while (true) {
                findPath(s, t);
                if (flow[t] == 0) break;
                for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur = edges.get(parent[cur]).from) {
                    int idx = parent[cur];
                    edges.get(idx).flow -= flow[t];
                    edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow += flow[t];
                    totalCost += edges.get(idx).cost * flow[t];
                }
                totalFlow += flow[t];
            }
        }
    }

    static int IN_NODE(int x) {
        return 2 * x;
    }

    static int OUT_NODE(int x) {
        return 2 * x + 1;
    }

    static MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow();

    static void connect(int i, int j, int x, int y) {
        int n1 = i * N + j;
        int n2 = x * N + y + N * N;
        mcf.addEdge(OUT_NODE(n1), IN_NODE(n2), 0, 1000000);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        List<String> a = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> b = new ArrayList<>();
        N = n;
        int si = -1, sj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            a.add(line);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (line.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    si = i;
                    sj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b.add(br.readLine());
        }
        mat = a;
        mat2 = b;
        List<int[][]> v = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[][]> vv = new ArrayList<>();
        v1 = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(v1[i], 1000000);
        }
        int[][] vInit = new int[N][N];
        FloodFill.init(si, sj, vInit);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                v1[i][j] = vInit[i][j];
            }
        }
        FloodFill.buildGraph(a, vv);
        int totalNodes = 4 * N * N + 2;
        mcf.reset(totalNodes);
        int src = 4 * N * N;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            mcf.addEdge(src, IN_NODE(i), 0, 1000000);
            mcf.addEdge(OUT_NODE(N * N + i), src + 1, 0, 1000000);
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a.get(x).charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y;
                    mcf.addEdge(IN_NODE(k), OUT_NODE(k), 0, a.get(x).charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(x).charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y + N * N;
                    mcf.addEdge(IN_NODE(k), OUT_NODE(k), 0, b.get(x).charAt(y) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(i).charAt(j)) && b.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < vv.size(); k++) {
                        int[][] dist = vv.get(k);
                        if (dist.length == 0) continue;
                        int x2 = k / N;
                        int y2 = k % N;
                        if (dist[i][j] == -1 || dist[i][j] > t) continue;
                        connect(x2, y2, i, j);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        mcf.run(src, src + 1);
        System.out.println(mcf.getFlow());
    }
}

class Pair<U, V> {
    public final U first;
    public final V second;
    public Pair(U first, V second) {
        this.first = first;
        this.second = second;
    }
}
